description:
The /tree overlay has no node-folding capability. Upstream supports collapsing subtrees at branch points.

## Upstream behavior (tree-selector.ts)

### State
- foldedNodes: Set<string> — IDs of collapsed nodes
- visibleChildrenMap / visibleParentMap — maintained after every applyFilter()

### Keybindings
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| ctrl+left / alt+left (app.tree.foldOrUp) | Fold current node if foldable and not folded; else jump to previous branch segment start |
| ctrl+right / alt+right (app.tree.unfoldOrDown) | Unfold current node if folded; else jump to next branch segment start or branch end |

### Fold markers in connector position (render(), lines 640-660 in tree-selector.ts)
When a node has a connector (├─ or └─), the second character of the connector is replaced:
- Node is folded → ⊞ (shown at connector pos 1)
- Node is foldable but not folded → ⊟ (shown at connector pos 1)
- Otherwise → ─

For root nodes (no connector) that are folded:
- A separate foldMarker = theme.fg("accent", "⊞ ") is prepended before the path marker

### isFoldable logic (isFoldable() method)
A node is foldable if:
1. It has visible children (in visibleChildrenMap), AND
2. It is a root (no visible parent) OR it is a branch-point start (its visible parent has >1 visible children)

### applyFilter integration
After applying filter mode and search, filteredNodes filters out descendants of foldedNodes (skipSet).
All filter-mode changes (ctrl+d/t/u/l/a/o) also call foldedNodes.clear().

### findBranchSegmentStart (navigation for foldOrUp / unfoldOrDown)
- "up" direction: walk visibleParentMap until we reach a node whose parent has >1 visible children;
  return the first such node (the segment start). Fall back to root if no branch point found.
- "down" direction: walk visibleChildrenMap following the first child until we reach a node with >1
  children (branch point), return children[0]; or return last node if end of chain.

## Elixir gaps

- No foldedNodes field in %OctoPi.TUI.Components.TreeSelector{}
- No app.tree.foldOrUp / app.tree.unfoldOrDown handlers in handle_key/2
- render_node/4 in coder/tree_selector.ex always uses "─" at connector pos 1 (no ⊞/⊟)
- filter/3 does not filter out folded descendants
- visibleChildrenMap / visibleParentMap not maintained in Elixir state

## Where to fix

### OctoPi.TUI.Components.TreeSelector (tui/components/tree_selector.ex)
- Add foldedNodes: MapSet.new() to struct
- Add handle_key/2 clauses for app.tree.foldOrUp and app.tree.unfoldOrDown
- Clear foldedNodes when any filter-mode key is pressed (already calls set_filter/2 — clear there)
- Implement fold_node/2, unfold_node/2, is_foldable/2
- Implement find_branch_segment_start/3 using visible_children_map / visible_parent_map

### OctoPi.Coder.Components.TreeSelector (coder/components/tree_selector.ex)
- filter/3 should accept foldedNodes and filter out their descendants (or add separate fold_filter/2)
- render_node/4: pass foldedNodes so connector pos 1 shows ⊟/⊞/─ correctly
- build_prefix_chars/5: use ⊟ or ⊞ instead of ─ at connector second char position

### State threading
- recalculate_visual_structure/2 already returns visible_children_map / visible_parent_map — these
  need to be stored in TUI TreeSelector state for isFoldable/findBranchSegmentStart lookups

## Upstream references
- handleInput() lines 900-1000 in tree-selector.ts (fold/unfold key handling)
- isFoldable() lines 1010-1020 in tree-selector.ts
- findBranchSegmentStart() lines 1022-1060 in tree-selector.ts
- applyFilter() lines 270-380 (fold filter) in tree-selector.ts
- render() fold marker display lines 640-680 in tree-selector.ts

## Verification
Create a branching session (send message, fork, send another). Open /tree, verify branch structure,
press ctrl+left to fold a branch, confirm descendants collapse and ⊞ appears on the node. Press
ctrl+right to unfold. Press ctrl+left on a non-foldable node to verify it jumps to segment start.
